name: sp-website
description: Landing page and waitlist for Synthetic Practitioner (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.waitlist:count: wrangler d1 execute sp-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist"
scripts.waitlist:export: wrangler d1 execute sp-waitlist --remote --json --command "SELECT email, name, region, household, interests, lang, consent_version, consent_at, created_at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at"
